HealthcheckRiskRule.Title: Accounts with AdminCount set but not member of privileged groups
HealthcheckRiskRule.TechnicalDetail: 5 users have stale adminCount: svc_backup, svc_sql, oldadmin1, oldadmin2, testadm
HealthcheckRiskRule.Remediation: Reset adminCount attribute and review group memberships.

HealthcheckRiskRule.Title: Domain trust with weak configuration
HealthcheckRiskRule.TechnicalDetail: Trust "legacy.corp.local" is bidirectional with SID filtering disabled
HealthcheckRiskRule.Remediation: Enable SID filtering or remove the trust.

HealthcheckRiskRule.Title: krbtgt password older than 180 days
HealthcheckRiskRule.Remediation: Double reset of the krbtgt password (2x with 10 hours interval).

HealthcheckRiskRule.Title: Computer with unconstrained delegation
HealthcheckRiskRule.Remediation: Switch to constrained delegation with protocol transition.
